mcp_tools.name: release_pack_changelog_seal_rollback
mcp_tools.title: Release pack changelog seal rollback
mcp_tools.description: Submits a release-pack record (version stamp and bump classification, changelog pack declarations with declared entry rows, seal record with declared sealed-artifact rows, tag and attachment, rollback detail with declared step rows, staged-rollout and health record, red lines) and returns a deterministic RELEASE_PACK_CHANGELOG_SEAL_ROLLBACK_READY / RELEASE_PACK_CHANGELOG_SEAL_ROLLBACK_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including semver bump arithmetic, declared checksum-format checks and rollback step-order checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared release-pack record only; it fetches no real release and verifies no real artifact.

inputSchema.description: The release pack changelog seal rollback manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
